payload.title: [HERMES-ENQUEUE-DIAG-001] Persist operator-grade enqueue errors across scheduler paths
payload.body:
## Summary

Audit every code path that sets `enqueueStatus` to `failed` or `partial` for **schedule**, **HTTP trigger**, and **manual** executions, and ensure each path appends at least one structured entry to the row’s `errors` JSON. Extend persistence so caught exceptions record **name**, **message**, and **stack** (when present), plus optional **phase** / **pipelineStepId** where the PRD’s canonical shape applies—without new DB columns.

## Delivery

**This ticket ships as a normal code PR** (or a small stack of PRs): scheduler / worker / manual enqueue changes, shared types, and Vitest coverage. The “audit checklist” in acceptance criteria is **evidence bundled with that PR** (e.g. a section in the PR description or a short `dev-docs` note linked from the PR)—not a standalone doc-only task with no code.

## Scope

- In scope: `packages/hermes/scheduler` / worker / manual enqueue flows that write `ScheduleExecution`, `HttpTriggerExecution`, `ManualPipelineExecution`; shared TypeScript type(s) for error entries; stack **size cap** (e.g. 32–64 KB) with a truncation indicator per PRD §7.
- Out of scope: New notifications, list/history UI, changing enqueue semantics beyond error recording.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] In the **same PR as the code**, the description (or a linked `dev-docs` note) includes an **audit checklist**: every branch that ends with `enqueueStatus = failed` or `partial` is listed and marked as having **`errors` non-empty** where a human-interpretable reason exists (PRD success metric: known failure paths persist at least one entry).
- [ ] When `enqueueAgentInvocations` (or equivalent) throws an `Error`, the persisted payload includes **`stack`** when `error.stack` is non-empty, not only `message` (REQ-003).
- [ ] Planning-phase failures attach **phase** (`planning` / `enqueue` / `transaction` — pick one enum and use consistently) and **pipelineStepId** when the failure is step-scoped (REQ-003).
- [ ] Legacy shape `{ message, timestamp }[]` remains valid; new fields are additive.
- [ ] Unit tests cover normalization/truncation of stacks and at least one representative enqueue failure fixture (Vitest, co-located `.test.ts`).
- [ ] No secrets are written into `errors` verbatim from resolved config; if messages must reference config, keep them generic or align with masking strategy in `HERMES-ENQUEUE-DIAG-003`.

## Dependencies

- Depends on: none
- Blocks: none (UI can ship before this completes for basic `{ message, timestamp }`; full REQ-003 AC needs this ticket)

## Notes

- PRD §10: extend JSON `errors` rather than new columns.
- Coordinate **`code`** strings (e.g. `ENQUEUE_BATCH_FAILED`) with `HERMES-ENQUEUE-DIAG-002` for display ordering if needed.

PRD: https://github.com/hyperjumptech/mediapulse/blob/prds/hermes-enqueue-failure-diagnostics.prd.md
